data.name: Combine Fighting Styles
data.description: When focused, and have used your Examine Technique on at least two creatures in the past hour, and have not expended focus since using Examine Technique, you can, as a swift action, treat your opponents as flat-footed when making attacks against them until the start of your next turn.  This can be used %1/day.|CombineFightingStylesTimes
